tagline.text: Integrated resort across from the airport with a casino, 5 hotels and a mall

location.label: Location
location.text: Newport Boulevard, Newport City, Pasay (across from NAIA Terminal 3)

best_season.label: Best time to visit
best_season.text: Year-round (indoor venues; getting around is easier in the November–May dry season)

budget.label: Budget
budget.text: About ₱1,000~5,000 (meals and shows per person, lodging not included)

children.text: Resorts World Manila opened in 2009 as the first integrated resort in the Philippines, and since 2022 its official name has been Newport World Resorts. Five hotels, a casino, Newport Mall and a theater stand across from NAIA Terminal 3, which makes it a handy stop during a layover.

Resorts World Manila is an integrated resort in Newport City, Pasay, Metro Manila. It had its soft opening on August 28, 2009, and on July 20, 2022 the operator's official brand changed to Newport World Resorts. Even so, taxi and Grab drivers still often call it Resorts World Manila, or simply "RWM," so it helps to know both names when you ask for directions.

The resort was built on land that was once part of the Villamor Air Base, directly across from NAIA Terminal 3. One compound holds a casino, five hotels, Newport Mall, the 1,500-seat Newport Performing Arts Theater, cinemas, restaurants and bars. That is why it is popular with layover travelers who cannot go far, with people who need a night near the airport before an early flight, and with families looking for an indoor place to relax on a rainy day.

The hotels are Hilton Manila, Sheraton Manila, Hotel Okura Manila, Manila Marriott Hotel and Holiday Inn Express Manila Newport City. According to Wikipedia, there are about 1,574 rooms in total. In late 2018 the Grand Wing, home to the Hilton, Sheraton and Okura, opened along with a new gaming area, and it now connects to the second level of Newport Mall by a bridge. The resort is run by Travellers International Hotel Group, part of the Alliance Global group, and Wikipedia says Genting Hong Kong, a former partner, sold its stake in 2023. The Marriott Grand Ballroom opened in July 2015 and is also used for weddings and events. Because the operator and facilities have changed several times, restaurant and hotel details on older blogs may differ from today, so keep that in mind.

The appeal here is convenience rather than sights. You do not come for Philippine monuments or natural scenery, but it is within walking distance of the airport and many facilities run around the clock, which makes it practical for your first or last night in the country. This guide covers how to get there, how to enjoy each facility, what to know about using the casino, and what to watch out for.

blocks.title: The Runway Manila footbridge to NAIA Terminal 3

children.text: This air-conditioned footbridge of about
leaves the Terminal 3 arrivals level, crosses Andrews Avenue and leads to Newport. Even with luggage, it usually takes about
5 minutes
to reach Newport Mall on the other side. It keeps you dry in the rain, which is convenient.

This indoor shopping and dining area sits at the heart of the resort, and the hotels and casino areas connect through it. With restaurants, cafés and convenience services in one place, it is a good spot to eat, exchange money or grab a snack in the short time before heading to the airport. Shops change often, so check the official information before you visit.

This land-based casino has slot machines, table games and electronic table games, and its gaming areas spread over several floors. The official site states that gambling is for ages 21 and over only. Even if you do not gamble, you can use the hotel and mall facilities separately. Wikipedia gives the gaming area as about

This theater seats about 1,500 and hosts concerts, musicals, ballet and other shows. The official site offers online ticket sales, and the schedule differs from season to season, so check before you visit.

Within the same compound you can choose from major chains such as Hilton, Sheraton, Okura and Marriott, up to the budget-friendly Holiday Inn Express. Being able to compare and book according to your budget and purpose inside one compound is a big advantage.

The official site lists many restaurants, including steakhouses and Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Filipino places. Oori Korean Restaurant is listed for Korean food, and names such as Gordon Ramsay Bar & Grill and Wolfgang's Steakhouse also appear. Tenants can change, so check before you go.

Megaworld Cinemas operates inside the compound, so you can catch a movie on a rainy day or in the evening. Hotel guests can use each hotel's pool and other facilities; conditions differ by hotel, so check when you book.

items.title: Layover plan for 4 to 6 hours
items.subtitle: Walk to Newport from the airport

children.text: After arriving at NAIA Terminal 3, first check whether luggage storage is available, then follow the Runway Manila footbridge signs on foot to Newport.
Have lunch at Newport Mall and look around briefly. If you want Korean food, look first at the Korean restaurant listed in the official information.
Relax in a hotel lobby lounge or café, or check the theater schedule. To be safe, head back to the airport at least
3 hours
before your next flight.
Walk back across the footbridge to Terminal 3 and check in.
International check-in closes early and NAIA immigration can get crowded, so leave plenty of time. If your flight uses a different terminal, you will need more transfer time.
Check in to your hotel and unpack.
Have dinner at Newport Mall or a hotel restaurant.
Catch a show if one is on the theater schedule, and if you are 21 or older you can look around the casino.
The next morning, have hotel breakfast, then walk the footbridge to Terminal 3.
According to the official site, it is about
15 minutes
by car from central Makati via the Skyway. It can take much longer at rush hour, on weekends and on show days.
In Grab or a taxi, enter "Newport City" or "Resorts World Manila" as the destination. Naming the hotel where you will get off makes it more precise.
Rush hours (weekdays 7–9 a.m. in the morning and 5–8 p.m. in the evening) are congested, so allow extra time.
From the Terminal 3 arrivals level, follow the Runway Manila footbridge and you reach Newport Mall in about
5–10 minutes
. The footbridge is an air-conditioned walkway of about
and is said to be free and open 24 hours.
The official site says a Runway Manila shuttle runs 24 hours from the Newport side. Fares and hours differ between sources, so confirm on site.
If you arrive at Terminal 1 or 2, you must first get to Terminal 3. Check NAIA information for transfers between terminals.

items.title: By air from abroad or other islands

children.text: If your flight arrives at NAIA Terminal 3, you can walk straight to the footbridge after immigration. If you arrive at Terminal 1 or 2, you need to get to Terminal 3 first and then walk.
It is easier to finish currency exchange and buying a SIM at the airport right after arrival before you come.
Because the venues are mostly indoors, the seasons matter little. In the rainy season, however, road flooding and traffic jams make trips to and from the city take longer.
Shows and events increase around the year-end season, so check the schedule on the official site and plan around it.

There are five hotels in the same compound, so you can choose to suit your purpose. The Hilton, Sheraton and Okura are known to be in the Grand Wing, and the Marriott and Holiday Inn Express in the main side. Room rates vary greatly by season, so compare several booking sites rather than looking at only one. If you need a night because of your flight time, being able to walk from Terminal 3 is the biggest advantage.

For meals, pick from the restaurants introduced on the official site. There are steakhouses and Chinese, Japanese and Korean restaurants, plus bars and lounges that stay open late. Restaurant hours and menus change often, so check before you go.

When you miss Korean food, Oori Korean Restaurant, listed on the official site, is a candidate; for Japanese there are names such as Yamazato and Ginzadon, for Chinese Hua Yuan and Man Ho, and for steak CRU and Wolfgang's Steakhouse. Among lounge bars are The Whisky Library and The Grand Bar and Lounge. Many places are on the pricey side, so check menu prices before you visit. If you just want something simple, the cafés and fast-food outlets in the mall are less of a burden.
The official name is Newport World Resorts, but taxi and Grab drivers often understand only Resorts World Manila or RWM.
When walking from Terminal 3, follow the Runway Manila signs from the arrivals level. If you have a lot of luggage, check whether carts are allowed at the footbridge entrance.
If you visit before a flight, count the Terminal 3 check-in cutoff and immigration wait, and be back at least 3 hours before departure.
Only people 21 and older may enter the casino, and you must carry ID or a passport. The dress code was not confirmed with the official source, so it is safest to avoid shorts and slippers.
Popular show dates sell out quickly, so book in advance on the official site.
If you need a room, compare each hotel's rate against your flight schedule and check the cancellation policy.
You can call the official customer care line at +63 (2) 7908-8888.
Save your travel insurance, e-ticket and hotel confirmation on your phone for easy use at the entrance and front desk.
There is a casino here. Gambling is allowed only for ages 21 and over and carries a risk of addiction, so set a budget and stick to it.
On June 2, 2017, an arson and shooting incident took place in the casino. Security checks have since been tightened, so cooperate with screening when you enter.
Ignore taxi touts and offers of illegal money exchange, and use Grab or an official taxi.
Do not leave valuables or your wallet unattended inside the casino.
Roads near the airport can be quiet at night, so do not walk alone late at night; call a ride from the front of your hotel.
Operating hours and rules change often, so check the latest announcements.
